prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return CommonJS module solution.js.
Required API: exports.deadlineSequence = function(input)
Behavior: Parse start;delay,delay where start and every delay are canonical unsigned decimals in 0..10000000 and at least one delay is required. Add delays cumulatively with a maximum timestamp of 10000000. Return each resulting timestamp joined by commas; reject overflow or malformed input.
Visible example: 10;5,0,7 returns 15,15,22.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

Behavior: Parse start;delay,delay where start and every delay are canonical unsigned decimals in 0..10000000 and at least one delay is required. Add delays cumulatively with a maximum timestamp of 10000000. Return each resulting timestamp joined by commas; reject overflow or malformed input.
Visible example: 10;5,0,7 returns 15,15,22.

reference.code:
const f=s=>{const p=s.split(';'),u=/^(?:0|[1-9][0-9]*)$/;if(p.length!==2||!u.test(p[0])||!p[1])return null;let n=Number(p[0]),o=[];if(n>10000000)return null;for(const x of p[1].split(',')){if(!u.test(x))return null;n+=Number(x);if(n>10000000)return null;o.push(n)}return o.join(',')};
exports.deadlineSequence=f;
